intent: Persistent REST interrupts combat execution; model decision is not silently replaced by the old autopilot
policy_decision: Use configurable recovery HP ratio with default 0.75; this is an explicitly chosen executor recovery threshold, not a Ragnarok rule or species-based safety theorem
trigger: Explicit DamageTaken REST or an actual active script REST below its own health trigger
release: Received HP/MAXHP reach recovery ratio and actual native SELF standing acknowledgement gates resumed attacks
requirements: No same/next-tick attacks, loot, mechanical patrol after REST
Preserve suspended script and farm plan instead of replacing them on heartbeat KEEP
Monster ATTACK and KEEP do not erase recovery
Explicit FLEE preempts resting motion without automatically changing REST to FLEE; preserve recovery combat suspension until safe resumption
Event/native draining and keepalive remain active
Attack requires standing and resolves pending motion instead of bypassing pose guards
Rest requests paced; repeat received sitting does not flood sends
No inferred HP, pose, target difficulty or unseen actors
No model calls per mechanical recovery tick
protected: No packet table/manifest/new B6 tests edits; parallel finite packet review excludes recovery modules
known_limit: Rest under pursuit can still fail because sourced damage force-stands PCs; flee-then-rest is separate model policy, not silently imposed
